from drf_spectacular.views import SpectacularAPIView
from drf_spectacular.generators import SchemaGenerator

from .models import EnterprisePartner

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from drf_spectacular.views import SpectacularAPIView
from drf_spectacular.generators import SchemaGenerator
from rest_framework.response import Response
from .models import EnterprisePartner

class PartnerDynamicSchemaView(SpectacularAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        partner_id = request.query_params.get('partner_id')
        partner = EnterprisePartner.objects.get(id=partner_id)
        # Verify that the requesting user is an authorized developer for this partner organization
        if request.user.partner_id != partner.id:
            raise PermissionDenied('Access denied to OpenAPI specifications of external partners')

        generator = SchemaGenerator(
            urlconf=partner.custom_urlconf,
            title=f"{partner.name} Custom API"
        )
        schema = generator.get_schema(request=request, public=False)
        return Response(schema)
